pr_title: Bluetooth: Audio: Ensure that read callbacks can handle conn == NULL
pr_body:
The read callbacks may be called with conn == NULL if the device does a local read of the attributes. This commit ensures that all the read callbacks can handle the case where conn == NULL.

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/56086

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Ensure all GATT read callbacks can handle `conn == NULL`
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The GATT API for the read callback function states:
> The (ATT attribute read) callback can also be used locally to read the contents of the attribute in which case no connection will be set.

That effectively means that we should expect that the read callbacks may be called with `conn == NULL`, and we probably have quite a few read callbacks where we assume that `conn != NULL`. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Need to add `if (conn == NULL)` checks for all read callbacks. What to do in case that it is NULL, may depend on the individual read callback. 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**
One example of fixing this can be found in https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/56076
